terms_intro: By creating or using an account with this identity service, you agree to the terms below.
terms_s1_body: You are responsible for maintaining accurate account information and safeguarding your credentials, recovery contacts, and two-factor authenticators. Only create accounts for yourself or authorized applications.
terms_s2_body: You may not abuse the authentication APIs, attempt unauthorized access to other accounts, bypass rate limits, distribute malicious OAuth redirect URIs, or register misleading third-party applications.
terms_s3_body: When you authorize a third-party application, you grant it access only to the permissions shown on the consent screen. You can revoke any application's session from your account dashboard at any time.
terms_s4_body: Accounts that violate security policies or engage in abusive traffic may be suspended or blocked temporarily or permanently. You may schedule permanent deletion of your account at any time with a 30-day grace period.
terms_s5_body: The service is provided on an as-available basis. We may update these terms to reflect security or legal requirements and will publish updates with an updated effective date on this page.
privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect to authenticate you securely and how you control it.
privacy_s1_body: We store only the identity fields you provide (username, display name, profile icon, verified email/phone, hashed password, encrypted MFA secrets) alongside security metadata such as active session timestamps, IP addresses, user agents, and audit logs.
privacy_s2_body: Your data is used strictly to verify your identity, deliver one-time verification codes, defend against brute-force attacks, issue OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect tokens authorized by you, and let you review active sessions.
privacy_s3_body: We use strictly necessary HTTP-only session cookies for signed-in web authentication, language preference cookies, and local browser preferences (such as dark/light theme). We do not use third-party advertising trackers.
privacy_s4_body: Profile attributes are shared with third-party applications only after your explicit OAuth consent and strictly within the scopes you approve. Verification codes are dispatched solely through our configured email/SMS delivery providers.
privacy_s5_body: You can edit or unlink contact methods, terminate individual or all sessions, revoke OAuth apps, and request permanent account deletion directly from your dashboard. Upon completion of deletion, personal data, credentials, sessions, and owned OAuth clients are purged.
